facts.en: Completed an operations management diploma at Fictional Heron Academy in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构苍鹭学院完成运营管理文凭课程。

facts.en: Records clerk at Fictional Fern Assembly, 2020-02 to 2023-05.
facts.zh: 2020-02 至 2023-05 在虚构蕨叶装配机构任记录文员。

facts.en: Quality documentation coordinator at the same organization, 2023-06 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-06 至 2026-08 在同一机构任质量文档协调员。

facts.en: Collected process records and checked document revisions against the approved register.
facts.zh: 收集流程记录并依据获批登记表检查文档修订。

facts.en: Assembled evidence folders for an internal readiness review in 2025-09 with 2 process owners.
facts.zh: 2025-09 与 2 名流程负责人共同为内部准备情况审核整理证据文件夹。

facts.en: Personally indexed 58 records and listed missing attachments; process owners confirmed record accuracy.
facts.zh: 个人负责为 58 份记录编制索引并列出缺失附件；记录准确性由流程负责人确认。

facts.en: By the review date, owners supplied 10 of 13 missing attachments; 3 remained in the open-items log.
facts.zh: 截至审核日期，负责人补充了 13 项缺失附件中的 10 项；3 项仍列在未完成事项日志中。

facts.en: The quality manager determined findings and signed the review; the candidate did not issue an audit opinion.
facts.zh: 质量经理确定发现事项并签署审核；候选人未出具审核意见。

facts.en: Sent reminders and recorded owner responses without approving corrective-action closure.
facts.zh: 发送提醒并记录负责人答复，不批准纠正措施关闭。

facts.en: Uses revision-controlled registers, spreadsheet filters and document checklists.
facts.zh: 使用版本受控登记表、电子表格筛选及文档核对表。

facts.en: Drafted a corrective-action reminder schedule in 2026-03; only a small internal trial was approved.
facts.zh: 2026-03 起草纠正措施提醒计划；仅获批开展小规模内部试点。

facts.en: The trial covered 6 open items in 2026-04; no organization-wide rollout or compliance improvement was measured.
facts.zh: 试点于 2026-04 覆盖 6 个未完成事项；未测量组织范围内推广或合规改善。

facts.en: Attended an internal audit-awareness briefing in 2024; it did not confer auditor certification.
facts.zh: 2024 年参加内部审核意识简报培训；未因此获得审核员认证。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Repair Circle from 2024-05 to 2024-09 on weekends alongside the paid role.
facts.zh: 2024-05 至 2024-09 周末在虚构修理社做志愿者，与有薪岗位同期。

facts.en: Kept a volunteer tool-loan list; no safety inspection authority came with this activity.
facts.zh: 维护志愿活动工具借用清单；该活动不赋予安全检查权限。

facts.en: A personal 2022 shelving plan remained a sketch and was never installed.
facts.zh: 个人于 2022 年绘制的置物架计划停留在草图阶段，从未安装。

facts.en: A draft appraisal calls the candidate the audit signatory; this contradicts the signed manager review record.
facts.zh: 考评草稿称候选人为审核签署人；这与经理签署的审核记录矛盾。
